failure_modes.recovery: Only the tenant owner marks expenses reimbursed.
failure_modes.when: the caller is not the tenant owner (reimbursement moves real money)

failure_modes.recovery: Approve the expense first; only approved expenses are reimbursed.

preconditions: id is required. approved → reimbursed (owner only); stamps reimbursed_at.

description: Marks an approved expense as paid out — restricted to the tenant owner because it moves real money, and only an 'approved' expense qualifies (CONFLICT otherwise). Stamps reimbursed_at, after which the row's content freezes unconditionally since the amount approved is the amount recorded as paid. Records the payout only — no funds move automatically.
name: expense_reimburse
